comparison.objective: Fold a seatback tray up, hold it, flip its latch over the edge, and release; candidate breaks and recovers four tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual articulated support and latch engagement versus coaxial mandrel stabilization, hammer impact, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Tray remains stowed and latched after release versus all four tangs fractured and contained with inserts undisturbed.
comparison.reason: Although both use two hands, latching an articulated panel tests a different mechanism and outcome from controlled fracture.
